proposal: Rev 2: enclose a 900 × 1,220 mm shower between two fixed arched fluted returns (vanity side and WC side) with an open front, brass linear drain (rev 4: along the back wall under the mixer; rev 2–3 had it at the entry) and black border tile; fix the brass mixer set to the green-tiled wall; keep a dry 745 mm route to the WC and washer; add towel bar, robe hooks and hand-towel ring; keep the arched mirror within the vanity; tile the WC-side and niche walls; add a 25 L vertical geyser high in the corner of the door wall above the vanity (rev 3; a vertical tank does not fit over the door). Washer stays on a 610 mm marble-topped support with front upstand and laundry baskets below; inlet valve and RCD socket sit above the machine on opposite walls; drain hose runs behind to a standpipe; overhead cupboard raised to 6 ft 7 in.
risks_and_dependencies: The reference image shows a larger twin-panel shower; the narrower built room can accommodate the material language but its exact shower composition must follow site measurements and door clearances.
Marble alone must not carry the washer's dynamic load. The support frame, slab thickness, anchorage, vibration pads and appliance restraint need a structural/site detail before construction.
Actual washer cut sheet, door swing, inlet/drain hose limits, service isolation and overhead-cupboard clearances are unknown.
Master bathroom waterproofing, shower slope/drain and electrical wet-area protection remain subject to RFI-004 and RFI-005.
W9 opening and shaft protection remain subject to RFI-006.
Open 1,220 mm shower front will still let some splash reach the entry zone; a short fixed front panel is the fallback if the user wants it.

Linear-drain outlet: rev 4 channel runs along the back wall over the architect drain point (plan ≈ x 1.27, z 26.37–26.42 ft); outlet shift about 75 mm; depends on the actual sleeve and sunken-slab depth (the earlier '150 mm' figure was wrong and is superseded).

25 L vertical geyser body (~400 mm dia × 650 mm) is a placeholder; the selected model's height must fit between the 2,256 mm underside and the 3,048 mm ceiling with service access, and its wall fixing must carry the full tank.
